design_philosophy: Premium, calm, modern, human, subtly cinematic. An Awwwards-level site that avoids typical astrology clichés (no loud colors, glitter, or cheap zodiac icons). Focus on editorial whitespace, meaningful typography, and emotional connection.

headings.usage: Editorial, elegant feel. Used for H1, H2, H3, and manifesto statements.

body.usage: Highly readable, clean, modern sans-serif for body text, UI elements, and data points.

background.description: Warm ivory / clean white, offering a calming, premium base.

text.description: Soft charcoal instead of harsh pure black.

accent.description: Champagne gold for subtle premium highlights, CTA buttons, and delicate borders.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-black/5 or border-gold/20). Avoid heavy drop shadows; use delicate ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]).
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Spotlight effect, clipped frames (rounded-2xl or subtle arches), monochromatic or warm color grading to match the ivory/gold palette.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain (noise) overlay on the background. Use the starry sky image with very low opacity (10-15%) blended into the hero or footer background.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react with strokeWidth={1} or 1.5. Keep them minimal. Avoid literal zodiac illustrations; use abstract geometric or soft celestial shapes.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container padding px-6 sm:px-12.
layouts.grids: Bento-style grids for 'Why Us' and 'What Can You Ask' sections. Asymmetrical layouts with overlapping elements for the Manifesto section.
layouts.mobile_first: Ensure all tap targets are large. Sticky mobile CTA at the bottom of the screen. Stacked grids on mobile with smooth swipe/scroll snapping.

components.hero: Kinetic hero section. Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Subtle parallax celestial canvas background. Large editorial typography.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: Champagne gold background with charcoal text. Secondary: Outline with gold/charcoal border.
components.limited_slots_indicator: Small dot beside the 'BOOK NOW' CTA with a gentle pulse animation (animate-pulse, not flashing), text 'LIMITED SLOTS' in small caps.
components.booking_modal: 4-step flow (Name/DOB/Time/Place -> Questions -> Availability -> Confirm). Use Shadcn Dialog + Form. Clean, step-by-step UI with progress indicator.
components.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Massive serif numbers with descriptive text alongside.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee). Text like 'CLARITY • GUIDANCE • PURPOSE • CAREER • RELATIONSHIPS' separated by small stars (✦).
components.language_switcher: Minimal text toggle 'ENG | हिंदी' in the header/footer.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling setup in the root.
motion.reveals: Framer-motion scroll-reveals. Fade up and slight translate-y on scroll (duration: 0.8s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero background and gemstone images using framer-motion useScroll and useTransform.
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards (slight lift -translate-y-1), button scale down on tap (scale: 0.98).

hero_background.description: Subtle starry night sky. Use with low opacity overlay in hero/footer.

trust_hands.description: Two hands holding, symbolizing trust and guidance.

astrologer_portrait.description: Warm portrait for Shri Rajendra Kumar Gupta section.

gemstone_1.description: Purple gemstone macro shot for gemstone section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for the kinetic hero (masked text reveals) and scroll-triggered animations.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout.
Keep the aesthetic extremely minimal and editorial. Emphasize typography and negative space.
DO NOT use generic SVG zodiac icons. Use text, spacing, and subtle shapes (like thin circles or stars: ✦) as separators.
Ensure 'BOOK NOW' is a sticky CTA on mobile, pinned to the bottom of the viewport.
Build a Shadcn-based 4-step Dialog for the booking flow.
Use standard tags or Next/React image equivalents, styled with Tailwind classes like rounded-2xl or clip-paths for premium framing.
Do not use dark backgrounds globally. Stick to the Warm Ivory palette with Charcoal text and Gold accents.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure soft charcoal text on ivory background meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the parallax and kinetic reveals.
accessibility.interactive: All CTAs, inputs, and the booking modal must have explicit focus states (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-gold) and data-testid attributes.

testing.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., 'book-now-button', 'booking-modal-step-1', 'faq-accordion').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth with layered elements and z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT apply global transitions like 'transition: all'. Add specific transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep text left-aligned for natural reading.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emojis (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) as icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-12 to p-24) to create a premium, un-cramped feel.
NEVER use placeholder images. Rely on the provided image_urls.
